text:
trigger: none   # disable CI trigger

schedules:
- cron: "*/15 * * * *"
  displayName: "Run every 15 minutes"
  branches:
    include:
    - azure-pipelines
  always: true

pool:
  vmImage: windows-latest

steps:
- task: NuGetAuthenticate@1
  displayName: 'Authenticate to Azure Artifacts'

- pwsh: |
    $cacheFeedUrl = 'https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/powershell/PowerShell/_packaging/PSGallery-Cache-NoUpstream/nuget/v3/index.json'

    $totalPackages = @()

    $downloadBatchSize = 100
    $processed = 0
    $i = 0
    $processLastBatch = $false
    $firstScan = $true

    $LastPublishedDate = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(20)
    $checkpoint = $LastPublishedDate.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')

    while ($true) {
        $irmParams = @{
            Uri  = 'https://www.powershellgallery.com/api/v2/Search()'
            Body = @{
                '$filter'         = "Published gt datetime'$checkpoint'"
                '$orderby'        = 'Published'
                '$inlinecount'    = 'allpages'
                '$skip'           = $i
                '$top'            = $downloadBatchSize
                includePrerelease = $true
            }
        }

        $packages = Invoke-RestMethod @irmParams

        if (-not $packages) {
            if ($firstScan) {
                Write-Verbose -Verbose "No packages found after $LastPublishedDate"
                return
            }
        }
        else {
            $processed += $packages.Value.Count
            Write-Verbose "Processed $processed packages"

            $totalPackages += $packages

            if ($packages.Value.Count -lt $downloadBatchSize) {
                $processLastBatch = $true
            }
        }

        $firstScan = $false
        $i += $downloadBatchSize

        if ($processLastBatch) {
            break
        }
    }

    Write-Verbose "Found packages: $($totalPackages.Count)" -Verbose
    Write-Verbose "Found packages: $($totalPackages.Name)" -Verbose

    $totalPackages | ForEach-Object { 
        $packageName = $_.properties.Id
        $packageVersion = $_.properties.Version
        Write-Verbose -Verbose "Saving $packageName -- $packageVersion"
        Save-PSResource -Name $packageName -Version $packageVersion -Path '$(Pipeline.Workspace)' -AsNupkg -TrustRepository
    }
  displayName: Find modules to sync
  retryCountOnTaskFailure: 2

- task: NuGetCommand@2
  inputs:
   command: push
   packagesToPush: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/*nupkg'
   publishVstsFeed: PowerShell/PSGallery-Cache-NoUpstream
   allowPackageConflicts: true
